rationale: Build on the recurrent-tail QK best by tightening the exact export path instead of changing training dynamics: keep the small output tensors in FP32 during final int8+zlib serialization, and stop EMA from averaging already-rescued recurrent QKV/control tensors that are now preserved accurately. This directly targets final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact val_bpb on the current best family, keeps shapes and wallclock behavior unchanged, and spends the remaining size headroom on the proven recurrent-tail/export path rather than new heads or broader hyperparameter sweeps.
title: Exact Output FP32 And EMA-Carved Recurrent Tail Endgame
